description: Finalize the purchase of a paid marketplace asset. Requires a signed x402 payment payload from the buyer's wallet. First call get_payment_requirements to obtain the payment requirements, sign them with your EVM wallet, then pass the signed payload here. Returns the purchase receipt including a directDownloadUrl — you can GET that URL with your X-Aion-Key header to download the file immediately, no extra steps needed.

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment payload from the buyer's wallet.

payload.description: Signed payment payload including the EIP-712 signature.

uploadId.description: Upload ID of the marketplace asset to purchase.

name: purchase_asset

directDownloadUrl.description: Authenticated API endpoint for direct file download. GET this URL with your X-Aion-Key header to stream the file immediately after purchase.

downloadUrl.description: Public URL to download the purchased asset.

payerAddress.description: Wallet address that paid for the asset.

title: Purchase Asset
